verdict.rationale: Headless or CI operation is a fair question for an AI agent product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only that Muse keeps working on schedules and events after the app is closed, which is an adjacent background-autonomy feature and not a user-invokable headless or CI mode. Probes found no public API spec, no CLI, and no keyless developer surface (llms.txt and openapi.json return 401; the MCP card and api.muse.ai /v1/ping return 404), and access is only through the mobile, Mac and WhatsApp chat clients.
